name: AD4 P2.1 - Relearn (run the learning Actions in order)

parameters.content:
## What this is

The only workflow in AD4 that holds a GitHub token.

The Synthesis page has a "Learn from what has settled" button. It cannot start a GitHub Action itself - a page that could would be a page carrying a credential, and that credential would end up in the browser bundle. So the button calls this workflow's webhook, and the token lives here.

### Set up
1. Config -> github_owner / github_repo
2. Config -> github_token: a fine-grained PAT scoped to that ONE repository, with Repository permissions -> Actions: Read and write. Nothing else.
3. Activate the workflow, copy the Production webhook URL, and paste it on the AD4 Workflows page as P2.1_relearn.

NEVER put this token in Vercel or in any NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable.
